title: The external effects of tax reduction incentive policies on green innovation – from the perspective of supply chain spillovers
title_zh: 减税激励政策对绿色创新的外部效应——基于供应链溢出视角
title_primary: 减税激励政策对绿色创新的外部效应——基于供应链溢出视角
title_secondary: The external effects of tax reduction incentive policies on green innovation – from the perspective of supply chain spillovers
authors: Yixiang Duan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Tax incentive policies are widely used to foster green innovation, but their supply-chain spillovers remain underexamined. This paper explores the impact of upstream and downstream firms’ tax incentives on midstream enterprises’ green innovation using China’s National Enterprise Tax Survey Data and listed firm data spanning 2008–2016. Baseline estimates indicate that downstream tax-incentive exposure is positively and statistically significantly associated with midstream green innovation, whereas no robust statistically significant association is found for upstream exposure. Innovation-composition tests further show that downstream exposure is associated with more green patent applications, a higher green share, fewer non-green patent applications, and no statistically significant change in total patent applications, indicating a green-oriented reallocation rather than a general expansion of innovation. On this basis, this paper further takes China’s 2014 Accelerated Depreciation Policy for Fixed Assets as a quasi-natural experiment and applies the Double Machine Learning (DML) method to provide policy-based identification evidence on tax incentives and supply-chain green innovation spillovers. Mechanism analysis provides evidence consistent with liquidity, corporate-vitality, and ESG-related channels. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the downstream coefficient is larger and statistically significant among midstream enterprises facing stricter environmental regulation, employing executives with environmental backgrounds, or receiving greater media attention. KEYWORDS: Tax reduction incentives supply chain spillovers green innovation double machine learning JEL CLASSIFICATION: H23 Q55 O38
abstract_zh: 税收激励政策被广泛用于促进绿色创新，但其供应链溢出效应尚未得到充分研究。本文利用2008-2016年中国全国企业税收调查数据和上市公司数据，探讨上下游企业税收激励对中游企业绿色创新的影响。基准估计表明，下游税收激励暴露与中游绿色创新呈正向且统计显著的相关关系，而上游暴露则未发现稳健的统计显著关联。创新构成检验进一步显示，下游暴露与更多绿色专利申请、更高绿色占比、更少非绿色专利申请相关，而专利申请总量无统计显著变化，表明这是一种绿色导向的重新配置而非创新的普遍扩张。在此基础上，本文进一步以中国2014年固定资产加速折旧政策为准自然实验，采用双机器学习方法，为税收激励与供应链绿色创新溢出提供基于政策的识别证据。机制分析提供了与流动性、企业活力及ESG相关渠道一致的证据。异质性分析表明，在面临更严格环境规制、拥有环境背景高管或受到更多媒体关注的中游企业中，下游系数更大且统计显著。关键词：减税激励 供应链溢出 绿色创新 双机器学习 JEL分类：H23 Q55 O38

title: “Girls with girls”: gender composition and team performance in survey data collection
title_zh: 女孩与女孩”：性别构成与调查数据采集中的团队绩效
title_primary: 女孩与女孩”：性别构成与调查数据采集中的团队绩效
title_secondary: “Girls with girls”: gender composition and team performance in survey data collection
authors: Qing Huang, Yingyue Quan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the impact of gender composition on team performance in a real-world setting using a large-scale survey conducted within Chinese firms. We study the performance of two-person interviewer teams, with gender composition randomly assigned, tasked with complex survey data collection. Our analysis shows that two-female teams outperform both mixed-gender and two-male teams in interview completion and refusal-based questionnaire quality. Specifically, assignment to an all-female team increases the likelihood of completing an interview by 2.4%, and reduces refusals to answer key questions by 5%. This performance difference is likely driven by improved task coordination and a more favorable communication environment in all-female teams. This leads to increased effort input and ultimately enhances team effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 我们利用在中国企业内部开展的大规模调查，在真实情境中探究性别构成对团队绩效的影响。研究对象为随机分配性别组合的两人访谈员团队，其任务为完成复杂的调查数据采集工作。分析表明，全女性团队在访谈完成率和基于拒答的问卷质量方面均优于混合性别团队及全男性团队。具体而言，被分配至全女性团队可使访谈完成概率提升2.4%，并将关键问题拒答率降低5%。这一绩效差异很可能源于全女性团队中任务协调的改善与更有利的沟通环境，进而促使团队成员投入更多努力，最终提升团队效能。

title: Betting on Hitler - The Value of Political Connections in Nazi Germany
title_zh: 押注希特勒——纳粹德国政治关联的价值
title_primary: 押注希特勒——纳粹德国政治关联的价值
title_secondary: Betting on Hitler - The Value of Political Connections in Nazi Germany
authors: Hans-Joachim Voth, Thomas Ferguson, Stéphane Benveniste, Renaud Coulomb, Marc Sangnier 等
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine the effect of close ties with the NSDAP on the stock price of listed firms in 1932-33. We consider not only links between the National Socialists and executives, as was common in earlier work, but also with supervisory board members ? whose importance is hard to overestimate in the case of German industry. One implication of our work is that, weighted by stock market capitalization in 1932, more than half of listed firms on the Berlin stock exchange had substantive links with the NSDAP. Crucially, stock market investors recognized the value of these links, sending the share prices of connected firms up as the new regime became firmly established. While the market as a whole rose after Hitler?s accession to power, firms with board members known to favour the party (or backing it financially) outperformed the market by 5-10% between January and May 1933. We show that this finding is robust to a range of additional control variables and alternative estimation techniques.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1932-1933年间与纳粹党（NSDAP）的密切关系对上市公司股票价格的影响。我们不仅考虑了纳粹党与高管之间的联系（这在早期研究中较为常见），还关注了与监事会成员的联系——在德国工业的背景下，后者的重要性无论如何强调都不为过。我们的研究结论之一是，按1932年股票市值加权计算，柏林证券交易所超过一半的上市公司与纳粹党存在实质性联系。关键在于，股票市场投资者认识到了这些联系的价值，随着新政权稳固建立，关联企业的股价随之上涨。尽管希特勒上台后整个市场整体上扬，但在1933年1月至5月期间，董事会成员已知支持该党（或为其提供资金支持）的企业表现优于市场5-10%。我们证明，这一发现在一系列额外控制变量和替代估计方法下依然稳健。

title: Financial Frictions, Investment, and Institutions
title_zh: 金融摩擦、投资与制度
title_primary: 金融摩擦、投资与制度
title_secondary: Financial Frictions, Investment, and Institutions
authors: Stijn Claessens, Yishay Yafeh, Kenichi Ueda
official: 官方在线 2010-12-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Financial frictions have been identified as key factors affecting both short-term economic fluctuations and long-term growth. An important policy question therefore is whether institutional reforms can reduce financial frictions and, if so, which reforms are best? We address this question by empirically investigating the effects of institutions on financial frictions using a canonical investment model. We consider two channels by which frictions affect investment: (i) through financial transaction costs at the individual firm (micro) level; and (ii) through the required rate of return at the country (macro) level. Using a panel of 75,000 firm-years across 48 countries for the period 1990-2007, we examine how, through these frictions, institutions affect investment. We find that improved corporate governance (e.g., less severe informational problems) and enhanced contractual enforcement reduce financial frictions affecting investment, while stronger creditor rights (e.g., lower collateral constraints) are less important.
abstract_zh: 金融摩擦已被确认为影响短期经济波动与长期增长的关键因素。因此，一个重要的政策问题是：制度性改革能否减少金融摩擦？若能，何种改革最为有效？为回答这一问题，我们采用经典投资模型，实证研究了制度对金融摩擦的影响。我们考虑了摩擦影响投资的两条渠道：（i）通过单个企业（微观）层面的金融交易成本；（ii）通过国家（宏观）层面的必要回报率。基于1990-2007年间48个国家75,000个企业-年度观测值构成的面板数据，我们考察了制度如何通过上述摩擦渠道影响投资。研究发现：改善公司治理（如减轻信息不对称问题）与强化合同执行力度能够降低影响投资的金融摩擦，而增强债权人权利（如降低抵押品约束）的作用相对较弱。

title: Disastrous Displacement: The Long-Run Impacts of Landslides
title_zh: 灾难性迁移：山体滑坡的长期影响
title_primary: 灾难性迁移：山体滑坡的长期影响
title_secondary: Disastrous Displacement: The Long-Run Impacts of Landslides
authors: Baseler, Travis, Hennig, Jakob
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Natural disasters displace millions of people a year, but their economic impacts are difficult to study when the affected population becomes dispersed. This paper estimates the longrun impacts of six landslides in Uganda on nearly the full affected population. The analysis exploits the sharp boundaries between households residing in a landslide path and those on the same slopes but outside the path. Years after the landslides, affected households earn 50% less income and are 18 percentage points less likely to report being satisfied with their lives. Further analysis points to social capital as a determinant of successful post-disaster recovery.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害每年导致数百万人流离失所，但当受灾人口分散时，其经济影响难以研究。本文估算了乌干达六次山体滑坡对几乎全部受灾人口的长期影响。分析利用了滑坡路径内住户与同处同一山坡但位于路径外住户之间的清晰边界。滑坡发生数年后，受灾家庭收入减少50%，对生活表示满意的可能性降低18个百分点。进一步分析表明，社会资本是灾后成功恢复的决定性因素。

title: The Effects of Education on Corruption: Evidence from Vietnam's University Expansion
title_zh: 教育对腐败的影响：来自越南大学扩张的证据
title_primary: 教育对腐败的影响：来自越南大学扩张的证据
title_secondary: The Effects of Education on Corruption: Evidence from Vietnam's University Expansion
authors: Malesky, Edmund J., Mattsson, Martin, Vu, Khoa, Zhang, Liaoliang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Education and corruption are negatively correlated at the cross-national level, but little is known about the causal relationship between the two. We combine newly-collected data on timing and locations of Vietnam's national expansion of universities with detailed survey data on experiences of corruption from over 170,000 respondents in 320 districts across 12 years. Using staggered difference-in-differences, we show that cohorts exposed to the university expansion are 78% more likely to have a university education. However, this increase neither translates into fewer individuals being affected by corruption nor increases the propensity to denounce corrupt officials. Instead, we find that education increases exposure to corruption at the individual level. The mechanism for this increase that is most consistent with our data is that education raises household income and higher income leads to more bribe payments.
abstract_zh: 教育与腐败在国家层面呈负相关，但两者间的因果关系尚不明确。本研究将越南全国大学扩张的时间与地点新数据，与涵盖12年间320个地区逾17万受访者腐败经历详情的调查数据相结合。采用交错双重差分法分析发现，受大学扩张影响的群体接受高等教育的概率提升78%。然而，这一增长既未转化为受腐败影响人数的减少，也未提高举报腐败官员的倾向。相反，我们发现教育在个体层面增加了腐败暴露风险。与数据最吻合的机制解释是：教育提高了家庭收入，而更高收入导致更多贿赂支出。

title: Exploring the perspectives of urban allotment gardens in Czechia: Balancing food production, recreation, ecology and housing
title_zh: 探索捷克城市分配菜园的视角：平衡粮食生产、休闲、生态与住房
title_primary: 探索捷克城市分配菜园的视角：平衡粮食生产、休闲、生态与住房
title_secondary: Exploring the perspectives of urban allotment gardens in Czechia: Balancing food production, recreation, ecology and housing
authors: B. Duží, Petr Dvořák, Jan Vávra, Šimon Jelínek
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper explores the recent developments in urban allotment gardens (UAGs) in Czechia, situating them within ongoing debates in urban planning across Central and Eastern Europe. Responding to increasing pressures on urban land, the study has two main goals: (1) to identify key trends in urban gardening, and (2) to develop a typology of UAGs relevant for local authorities. The research focused on diverse cities—Uherské Hradiště, Opava, Olomouc, and Ostrava—using geospatial methods, including historical and recent aerial imagery and orthophotographs, together with field research, to analyse the characteristics and development patterns of UAGs over time. We selected various UAGs and examined their features, such as location, size, plot count, and land-use patterns. Our findings led to the identification of four main types of UAGs: production-oriented (with at least 50% productive area), mixed production-recreation (with 25–45% dedicated to production, 25–55% to recreation), mainly recreation with housing potential (over 60% recreation area), and climate-adaptive (with at least 50% nature-recreation space). The findings reveal a common presence of mixed production-recreation UAGs, which tend to shift from food production to recreational or residential use. These trends are influenced by factors such as urban location, land ownership, planning policies, and gardening practices. The paper contributes to European debates on sustainable urban land management by critically examining the role of urban gardening in planning and providing evidence-based recommendations for local authorities.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了捷克城市 allotment 花园（UAGs）的最新发展，并将其置于中欧与东欧城市规划的持续讨论背景之中。面对城市土地日益增长的压力，本研究有两个主要目标：（1）识别城市园艺的关键趋势；（2）为地方政府制定一套与UAGs相关的类型学。研究聚焦于多样化的城市——乌赫尔堡、奥帕瓦、奥洛穆茨和俄斯特拉发，采用地理空间方法，包括历史和近期航拍影像及正射影像，结合实地调研，分析UAGs随时间变化的特征和发展模式。我们选取了多种UAGs，并考察了其位置、规模、地块数量及土地利用模式等特征。研究结果识别出四种主要类型的UAGs：生产导向型（生产面积至少占50%）、生产与休闲混合型（生产面积占25%–45%，休闲面积占25%–55%）、以休闲为主且具备住房潜力型（休闲面积超过60%），以及气候适应型（自然休闲空间至少占50%）。研究发现，生产与休闲混合型UAGs普遍存在，并倾向于从食品生产转向休闲或居住用途。这些趋势受城市区位、土地所有权、规划政策及园艺实践等因素的影响。本文通过批判性审视城市园艺在规划中的作用，并为地方政府提供基于证据的建议，为欧洲关于可持续城市土地管理的讨论做出了贡献。

title: 政府共享数据对产业结构变迁和经济增长的影响

abstract: 政府数据共享是数据要素融入实体经济发展的重要方式之一，本文主要研究政府共享数据对产业结构变化和经济增长的影响机制和效应。本文首先分析了中国政府共享数据的发展规律和特征事实，研究发现，服务业部门的政府共享数据产出弹性显著大于工业部门。基于这一特征事实，本文构建了一个两部门的动态一般均衡模型，从理论上分析政府共享数据对产业结构和经济增长的影响。理论研究发现，政府共享数据会通过直接的数据深化效应和间接的...

title: Noncausal AR processes driven by causal GARCH volatility
title_zh: 因果GARCH波动驱动的非因果AR过程
title_primary: 因果GARCH波动驱动的非因果AR过程
title_secondary: Noncausal AR processes driven by causal GARCH volatility
authors: Daniel Velásquez-Gaviria, Jean-Michel Zakoïan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the introduction of causal conditional heteroskedasticity in noncausal autoregressive (AR) models. We demonstrate that, in this framework, large shocks to the innovation process driving the GARCH error term of a noncausal AR model result in heightened volatility immediately before and after a bubble crash. The non-coincidence of the σ -fields generated by past observations and past values of the GARCH process makes statistical inference nonstandard. In particular, the full quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE) is generally inconsistent. We investigate the asymptotic properties of three-step weighted least squares estimators of the AR coefficient and the QMLE of the volatility parameters. Our findings are illustrated by Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial data.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在非因果自回归（AR）模型中引入因果条件异方差性的方法。我们证明，在该框架下，驱动非因果AR模型GARCH误差项的创新过程中的大幅冲击，会导致泡沫崩溃前后波动性显著加剧。由于过去观测值生成的σ域与GARCH过程过去值生成的σ域不重合，统计推断变得非标准。具体而言，完全拟极大似然估计量（QMLE）通常不一致。我们研究了AR系数的三步加权最小二乘估计量以及波动率参数的QMLE的渐近性质。通过蒙特卡洛实验和对金融数据的实证应用，本文验证了上述发现。

title: The effect of master’s level social worker licensing reform in Illinois
title_zh: 伊利诺伊州硕士级社会工作者执照改革的影响
title_primary: 伊利诺伊州硕士级社会工作者执照改革的影响
title_secondary: The effect of master’s level social worker licensing reform in Illinois
authors: Edward J. Timmons, Lawrence Han, Joshua Bandoch
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Shortages of healthcare professionals, particularly in mental health, remain an ongoing policy dilemma. Licensing requirements may be one potential factor contributing to this shortage. In 2022, Illinois eliminated the exam requirement for master’s level social workers (MSWs). Using data on the number of MSWs from several states, we estimate the effect of this policy change on the number of MSWs in Illinois using the synthetic control method. We find evidence that the elimination of the exam requirement increased the number of active MSW licenses in Illinois by approximately 2,600 licensees– a 50% increase. We also provide evidence that our estimates are both economically and statistically significant.

title: Resource Misallocation in European Firms: The Role of Constraints, Firm Characteristics, and Managerial Decisions
title_zh: 欧洲企业资源错配：约束、企业特征与管理决策的作用
title_primary: 欧洲企业资源错配：约束、企业特征与管理决策的作用
title_secondary: Resource Misallocation in European Firms: The Role of Constraints, Firm Characteristics, and Managerial Decisions
authors: Yuriy Gorodnichenko, Debora Revoltella, Jan Svejnar, Christoph T. Weiss
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using a new survey, we document high dispersion of marginal revenue products across firms in the European Union. To interpret this dispersion, we develop a highly portable framework to quantify gains from better allocation of resources. We demonstrate that apart from direct measures of distortions, firm characteristics, such as demographics, quality of inputs, utilization of resources, and dynamic adjustment of inputs, are predictors of the marginal revenue products of capital and labor. We emphasize that some firm characteristics may reflect compensating differentials rather than constraints and the effect of constraints on the dispersion of marginal products may be smaller. (JEL D22, D24, D25, E23, G31, L25)
abstract_zh: 基于一项新调查，我们记录了欧盟企业内部边际收益产品的高度离散性。为解释这一离散现象，我们构建了一个高度可移植的框架，用以量化资源优化配置带来的收益。研究表明，除直接衡量扭曲程度的指标外，企业特征（如人口统计特征、投入品质量、资源利用率及投入的动态调整）均可预测资本与劳动的边际收益产品。我们强调，部分企业特征可能反映补偿性差异而非约束条件，且约束条件对边际产品离散性的影响可能较小。（JEL分类号：D22, D24, D25, E23, G31, L25）

abstract: This study reconstructs the programmatic core of land consolidation as a technology–governance composite grounded in spatial justice, organized through a three-stage sequence of entry diagnostics, process assembly, and institutional safeguards. Within this framework we identify four institutional pillars that render works, rights, and ecology commensurable: transparent valuation and equivalence, registration of rights with write-through, public disclosure with graduated remedies, and legally binding ecological safeguards, the last constituting a hard floor rather than an optional add-on. On this basis we develop a typology and a nine-module assembly grammar. Methodologically we combine realist synthesis (Context–Mechanism–Outcome) with structured focused comparison across global cases, formalizing decision nodes and milestones. Findings: A-type (European prototype) is the minimal complete set combining the four pillars with the three-stage sequence; B-type (institutional assembly) stabilizes delivery under fiscal and organizational constraints via land banks, compensation scaffolding, and phased rollout; C-type (platform synthesis) adds multi-objective coordination and stage-gate cadence to the pillar stack; D -type (foundational reform) appears in thin-capacity settings as pilot consolidation on customary substrate ( D -narrow) or substrate-building through statutory scaffolding, cadastral modernization, and customary-tenure recognition ( D -broad). Types are diagnostic outcomes determined by P-module operational status rather than country labels; the full diagnostic is formalized as a decision tree that takes statutory substrate, administrative capacity, stakeholder base, and ecological exposure as inputs, applies four sequential pillar checks, and routes each case to one of five exits with explicit conversion rules between types. The paper's contributions are threefold: (1) it reframes land consolidation as a technology–governance composite with ecological safeguards as a hard floor; (2) it supplies a nine-module assembly grammar and a decision tree that constitutes a design-oriented diagnostic rather than a descriptive typology; and (3) it substitutes a module-status diagnostic for country-label classification, making feasible conversion trajectories explicit.
abstract_zh: 本研究将土地整治的重建为一种基于空间正义的技术—治理复合体，通过入门诊断、过程组装和制度保障三阶段序列进行组织。在此框架内，我们识别出四个制度支柱，使工程、权利与生态得以通约：透明估价与等价交换、权利登记与穿透式更新、公开披露与分级救济，以及具有法律约束力的生态保障，后者构成硬性底线而非可选附加项。在此基础上，我们发展出一种类型学及九模块组装语法。方法上，我们将现实主义综合（情境—机制—结果）与全球案例的结构化聚焦比较相结合，形式化决策节点与里程碑。研究发现：A型（欧洲原型）为最小完备集，结合四个支柱与三阶段序列；B型（制度组装）通过土地银行、补偿支架和分阶段推进，在财政与组织约束下稳定交付；C型（平台综合）在支柱堆栈上增加多目标协调与阶段门控节奏；D型（基础性改革）出现在能力薄弱环境中，表现为在习惯土地基质上的试点整治（D-窄型）或通过法定支架、地籍现代化及习惯产权承认进行基质建设（D-宽型）。类型是由P模块运行状态决定的诊断结果，而非国家标签；完整诊断被形式化为决策树，以法定基质、行政能力、利益相关者基础和生态暴露为输入，应用四项顺序支柱检查，并将每种情况路由至五个出口之一，且明确类型间转换规则。本文贡献有三：（1）将土地整治重新定义为技术—治理复合体，并将生态保障作为硬性底线；（2）提供九模块组装语法及构成设计导向诊断而非描述性类型学的决策树；（3）以模块状态诊断替代国家标签分类，使可行的转换轨迹明确化。

title: The value of water access security in agriculture
title_zh: 农业用水安全保障的价值
title_primary: 农业用水安全保障的价值
title_secondary: The value of water access security in agriculture
authors: Shahin Bahrami, Mani Rouhi Rad, Aaron Hrozencik, Gabriela Perez-Quesada, Rodolfo M. Nayga Jr
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Institutions are crucial for allocating natural resources. Surface water allocation in the western U.S. follows the prior appropriation doctrine, which distributes water based on the date when water was first appropriated for beneficial use. During scarcity, water is allocated by seniority, with holders of more junior rights losing access first. Curtailments of water access influence the profitability of irrigated production, especially in the arid West where most croplands depend on irrigation. The Ricardian theory of rent suggests a premium for senior water rights, as the net present value of long-term returns is higher due to more secure access. We estimate this premium using a hedonic pricing model and agricultural land transactions as proxies for water-rights values. Our dataset links roughly 25,000 sales across 37 Colorado counties with geocoded information on associated water rights. Results show that surface-water access increases land values by about $6,300 per acre, or 64 % relative to similar non-irrigated parcels. Furthermore, we estimate the premium for properties that are one year more senior in water rights to be about $49 per acre. Our results also indicate that properties with access to storage and supplementary groundwater rights sell, on average, for 16% and 14% more, respectively, compared to irrigated properties with only surface water access. These findings highlight the importance of water security in shaping agricultural land markets and offer insights into how policy measures, such as expanding water markets or investing in storage reservoirs, can potentially improve allocation and reduce vulnerability of irrigated agriculture.

title: Correcting sample selection bias in PISA rankings
title_zh: 修正PISA排名中的样本选择偏差
title_primary: 修正PISA排名中的样本选择偏差
title_secondary: Correcting sample selection bias in PISA rankings
authors: Onil Boussim
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper proposes a method to account for sample selection (survivor bias) in cross-country comparisons. International assessments such as the Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) observe outcomes only for students enrolled in school at age 15, which can distort comparisons in countries with high dropout rates. I consider a quantile-based selection correction that delivers bounds on countries’ average performance rather than point estimates. Using these bounds, I construct optimistic and pessimistic rankings, with each country’s true rank lying between the two. An application to PISA 2018 shows that correcting for selection bias leads to substantial changes in countries’ average scores and rankings.

title: The Green Peace Dividend: The Effects of Militarisation on Emissions and the Green Transition
title_zh: 绿色和平红利：军事化对排放与绿色转型的影响
title_primary: 绿色和平红利：军事化对排放与绿色转型的影响

authors: Balázs Markó
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper argues that military buildups lead to a significant rise in greenhouse gas emissions and can disrupt the green transition. Identifying military spending shocks, I use local projections to show that a percentage point rise in the military spending share leads to a 0.9–2% rise in total emissions, as well as a 1% rise in emission intensity, depending on the economy’s overall emission intensity. Using a dynamic production network model calibrated for the US, I find that a permanent shock of the same size would increase total emissions by between 0.25% and 1.38%, and emission intensity by between 0.12% and 1.06%. The empirical analysis tentatively suggests that green patenting may be reduced by 10–25% following such a shock, and the model suggests that investment in renewables could be crowded out by defence spending under certain circumstances, hindering the energy transition. I show in a directed technical change model that crowding out green innovation could result in the growth rate - not just the level - of emissions becoming higher. These effects can significantly raise climate damages. Depending on the social cost of carbon and the composition of a military spending shock, I estimate that permanently doubling the military spending share in the US in 2017 (equal to 3.3% of GDP) would have led to climate damages equivalent to between 0.05–1.81% of US GDP per year.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，军事扩张会导致温室气体排放显著增加，并可能阻碍绿色转型。通过识别军事支出冲击，我采用局部投影法证明：军事支出占比每上升1个百分点，总排放量将增加0.9%-2%，排放强度将上升1%（具体幅度取决于经济体的整体排放强度）。基于为美国校准的动态生产网络模型，我发现同等规模的永久性冲击将使总排放量增加0.25%-1.38%，排放强度提高0.12%-1.06%。实证分析初步表明，此类冲击后绿色专利数量可能减少10%-25%；模型则显示，特定条件下国防支出可能挤出可再生能源投资，阻碍能源转型。在定向技术变革模型中，我证明挤出绿色创新可能导致排放增长率（而非仅排放水平）上升。这些效应将显著加剧气候损害。根据碳的社会成本及军事支出冲击的构成，我估算：若2017年美国军事支出占比（相当于GDP的3.3%）永久性翻倍，由此导致的气候损害将相当于美国GDP的0.05%-1.81%/年。

title: Navigating Inflation: The Role of Food Values in Japanese Consumers' Price Search Intentions

title_primary: 驾驭通胀：食品价值观在日本消费者价格搜索意向中的作用

authors: Nobuhiro Ito, Tomoaki Murakami
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Global economic instability has raised food prices and household living costs, prompting consumers to reduce grocery expenditures. Unlike recessions, inflation tightens income constraints without substantially affecting unemployment; therefore, time constraints remain largely unchanged. Although prior research has mainly examined the impact of socioeconomic factors on saving behaviour during recessions, the potential role of personal values, directly affecting consumer decision‐making, under inflationary conditions has received less attention. To fill this gap, this study examines how food values, especially price‐related food values (price‐FV), influence Japanese consumers' intentions to search for price promotions and lower‐priced stores during inflation. We conducted an online survey in March 2023, applying best–worst scaling to measure food values, followed by a bivariate probit model to estimate their effects on price‐search intentions. Our results reveal a positive association between price‐FV and consumers' intentions to seek lower prices. However, the overall effect is modest, as approximately 50% of the respondents exhibit relatively low price‐FV. Even among those with high price‐FV, the joint probability of not engaging in price‐searching remains above 0.5, suggesting that active cost‐saving efforts are not widespread. Importantly, local food retail environments moderate this relationship: Consumers with high price‐FV and moderate‐distant store locations show greater search intentions than those with very close or very distant grocery stores, even when price‐FV levels are similar. These findings indicate that although price‐FV does influence price‐search intentions, its effect is conditional on local food retail environments. Thus, retailers may need to reconsider their promotional strategies to account for heterogeneous consumer responses depending on food values.

abstract: In recent decades, agriculture has become increasingly concentrated through horizontal mergers and acquisitions via corporate entities, and policy makers are concerned this will be exacerbated by the aging population of farm operators. To reduce market concentration in agriculture, many states have enacted policies to entice new prospective entrepreneurs into farming. Among these are tax credits for existing farm owners who lease or sell farmland to “beginning farmers.” These subsidies aim to compensate the lessor for the additional risk associated with leasing land to a new farming enterprise. This paper investigates the effect of Iowa's Beginning Farmer Tax Credit program on land leased to farmers, farm operators' average age, and various metrics of non‐corporate farm operations. Our point estimates suggest very small effects of the program on Iowa's prevailing farm trajectories with a budgetary cost of more than $100,000 per added independent farm.

title_primary: 再分配性土地改革、农业生产力与结构变迁：新的跨国证据

authors: Devashish Mitra, Abdulaziz B. Shifa, Lan Anh Tong, Mehmet A. Ulubasoglu
official: 官方在线 2026-03-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Large‐scale land reforms constitute a substantial redistribution of wealth and reallocation of agricultural land, which is a major form of asset and production input in developing countries. While land redistribution (from the rich to the poor) remains a highly controversial issue, extensive evidence on its effect is limited. Using the most comprehensive global dataset on land reforms available to date, we investigate the impact of redistributive land reforms on agricultural productivity, along with the resulting structural change in the economy. First, we document that these reforms reduce per‐hectare agricultural output and agricultural mechanization by a statistically significant and quantitatively large amount. Second, these effects get worse with repeated redistributions, underpinning the potentially detrimental impact of ownership insecurity arising from frequent redistributions. Third, we find that the employment share of agriculture increases while the shares of industry and service sectors decrease. Importantly, this reallocation of labor occurs despite falling labor productivity in agriculture, which to begin with is lower than in industry and services, suggesting a reduction in real GDP.

title: The employment effects of minimum wage hikes on job and geographical mobility: evidence from China

abstract: As most studies on the employment effects of the minimum wage rely on static employment frameworks, dynamic factors, such as labour mobility, have not been sufficiently explored. To address this gap in the literature, this study examines the employment effects of minimum wage hikes and the dynamic impact on job mobility (local position shifts) and geographical mobility (cross-regional labour relocation). We use data from the Urban Household Surveys in China from 2010 to 2014 and the China Household Finance Surveys from 2017 to 2019. The analysis reveals that minimum wage hikes negatively affect employment; however, the unemployment effect is nonlinear, with a less pronounced unemployment effect at the 60th percentile. From a dynamic perspective, the minimum wage hikes are associated with an increased likelihood of job transition among urban workers. Additionally, these transitions are often accompanied by a wage decline, especially in the low-friction service industry. Further, the hikes are associated with a higher incidence of return migrants and no significant increase in the aggregate unemployment rate. This study provides new evidence on the effects of minimum wage increases on dynamic job-mobility patterns and geographical reallocation, offering important new insights for minimum wage policies.
